usedFor: Shopify holds the products and Brix shows content on screens. “New Product” can run “Import Media from URL”, so an image goes into your signage library when the product exists.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Import Media from URL” in Brix
bestTemplate.why: The action adds an image, video or file to the media library from a public URL, which fits a product image ready to show in store.

watchOut: “Import Media from URL” needs a public URL, so a product image that is not public will not import. It adds to the library; it does not put anything on a screen.
